title: Charge Air Temperature Sensor Low Error
detail_of_failure: Low voltage is sensed in the temperature signal circuit of the charge (boost) pressure and temperature sensor.
controller_action: Operates with charge temperature as fixed value.
machine_effect: • Engine protection function by boost temperature does not operate. • Engine output is reduced. • The engine startability will be degraded at low temperatures.
related_information: • Input voltage from the charge air temperature sensor (boost temperature sensor) can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 18501 (V)) • Temperature sensed by the charge air temperature sensor (boost temperature sensor) can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 18500(℃)) • When the temperature sensor connector is disconnected, failure code for High Error [CA153] is shown instead of this failure code. • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector BOOST PRESS & IMT, and connect a socket to the male side.

measurements.point: Between BOOST PRESS & IMT (male) (3) and (4) Charge thermal characteristics / -40℃

steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector ECM. Connect a T-adapter to the female side.

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (23) and (47) REMARK The resistance value accords with the characteristics table for resistance value of charge air temperature sensor in cause 2.

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with ground circuit)
steps.procedure: If no failure is found by check on cause 3, this check is not required. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and BOOST PRESS & IMT, and connect a T-adapter to the female side of ECM.
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
